format: Native strict manifest contract; validation in src/gv_physical_acquisition.py, not JSON Schema dialect
hash_rule: SHA-256 over canonical sorted compact ASCII JSON excluding configuration_hash; allow_nan=False
raw_binding: metadata.hardware_configuration equals configuration_hash. Save the full hardware manifest and calibration registry separately; their hash does not certify physical authenticity.
readiness: Manifest validity never promotes PENDING, authorizes construction or proves calibration/timing/sensitivity. Physical acquisition is blocked.
